verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a hosted MCP server whose codemode tools cover the Paddle API for refunds, failed payments and subscriptions. It does not document any disputes or chargeback endpoint, nor any way to retrieve a dispute, assemble evidence or submit a response via API or agent. The only dispute-related mention is that Paddle, as merchant of record, provides chargeback defense itself, which is a separate service and does not give an agent an API workflow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent handle a dispute end-to-end, retrieving it, assembling evidence, and submitting the response via the API
